name: Are minor repairs like drywall cracks and sticking doors common in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Are minor repairs like drywall cracks and sticking doors common in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and surrounding areas like Centennial and Parker, extreme humidity shifts and soil movement often cause interior trim separation, door sticking, and drywall cracking along seams. Minor repairs here often require flexible caulking, proper expansion gaps, and durable joint tape suited to dry winter air and fluctuating seasonal temperatures. Addressing minor shifting early prevents small hairline drywall cracks and separated crown molding from turning into expensive structural finish issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Colorado's shifting soils and low humidity frequently cause seasonal drywall settlement cracks and sticking doors, which we resolve with durable, flexible finish repairs.
